qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Irreplaceable sovereign defense industrial infrastructure. Sole-source provider of the 5th-generation stealth fighter (F-35) with 3,000+ planned lifetime airframes across 19 partner nations, PAC-3 missile defense, THAAD, HIMARS, and Aegis naval combat systems. High barriers created by classified security clearances, specialized tooling, and FAR cost-plus/statutory procurement frameworks. Moat proven by 10-year median ROIC of 18.2% and gross margin stability around 12–13%. Primary erosion risks stem from Pentagon fixed-price developmental contract write-downs and customer monopsony margin caps.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (REJECT). World's premier defense prime contractor passes Gates 1–5 on sovereign defense necessity and an unassailable $160B+ backlog, but fails Gate 6 on balance sheet quality and earnings durability. Negative tangible equity (-$6.8B) resulting from decades of debt-funded share buybacks, elevated total debt ($21.7B) exceeding 4.0x normalized earnings, recurring multi-hundred-million fixed-price developmental contract write-downs, and working-capital delivery freezes (e.g. F-35 TR-3 milestone withholdings) violate Munger's peace-of-mind and peak-to-peak compounding standards. [5-10Y g: missiles/fire control volume 4.0% + F-35 sustainment 2.0% + contract indexation 1.0% + buyback 1.0% - fixed-price developmental drag 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Lockheed Martin is the world's largest defense contractor ($75.0B FY25 revenue, 72% US Government / DoD). Segment breakdown: Aeronautics ~$28.5B (F-35, C-130), Missiles and Fire Control ~$12.5B (PAC-3, HIMARS, Javelin), Rotary & Mission Systems ~$17.5B (Sikorsky, Aegis), Space ~$13.0B. 10-year median ROIC is 18.2% with multi-year FCF conversion averaging >100% ($6.9B FCF vs $5.0B Net Income in FY25; $18.4B 3-year cumulative FCF vs $17.3B Net Income). However, capital structure displays severe financial engineering: $21.7B in total debt against $6.7B in stockholders' equity, yielding -$6.8B in negative tangible equity due to aggressive debt-funded share repurchases. Total debt to FY25 net income stands at 4.33x (exceeding the 4.0x peace-of-mind threshold). Earnings power has degraded from a 2023 peak EPS of $27.55 to $22.31 in 2024 and $21.49 in 2025 due to classified fixed-price development program losses and F-35 TR-3 software delivery pauses, failing Gate 6.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
